t: You're at the memorial to Peter the Great, on Glaisher Street in a corner of Deptford, right beside the point where the River Thames meets Deptford Creek. It went up in 2000 to mark three hundred years since the Grand Embassy of the Russian Tsar. The sculptor is Mihail Chemiakin, a Russian-American artist from the nonconformist tradition of St Petersburg. Vyacheslav Bukhayev, a Soviet and Russian architect and sculptor, is credited with its design. It sits in the Royal Borough of Greenwich.
